topicName: Pagination, Filtering, and Searching in APIs
content:
[{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Pagination, Filtering, and Searching in Django APIs"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"When building robust RESTful APIs with Django and Django REST Framework (DRF), returning thousands of records in a single response can severely degrade performance. To manage large datasets efficiently, you need to implement pagination, filtering, and searching. This tutorial demonstrates how to implement these features using Django REST Framework."},{"order":3,"type":"subheading","text":"Prerequisites and Setup"},{"order":4,"type":"paragraph","text":"Ensure you have Django and Django REST Framework installed in your Python environment. You will also need the django-filter package to handle advanced filtering seamlessly."},{"order":5,"type":"code","text":"pip install djangorestframework django-filter"},{"order":6,"type":"paragraph","text":"Add 'rest_framework' and 'django_filters' to your INSTALLED_APPS inside your settings.py file."},{"order":7,"type":"code","text":"INSTALLED_APPS = [
    ...
    'rest_framework',
    'django_filters',
]"},{"order":8,"type":"subheading","text":"Step 1: Setting up Global Pagination"},{"order":9,"type":"paragraph","text":"Pagination breaks large result sets into smaller, manageable chunks (pages). DRF provides built-in pagination classes like PageNumberPagination and LimitOffsetPagination. You can configure global pagination defaults inside your settings.py file."},{"order":10,"type":"code","text":"REST_FRAMEWORK = {
    'DEFAULT_PAGINATION_CLASS': 'rest_framework.pagination.PageNumberPagination',
    'PAGE_SIZE': 10
}"},{"order":11,"type":"subheading","text":"Step 2: Implementing Filtering and Searching"},{"order":12,"type":"paragraph","text":"Filtering allows users to narrow down data based on exact field matches, while searching allows full-text queries across specified fields. To enable this, add the DjangoFilterBackend, SearchFilter, and OrderingFilter to your default filter backends or directly within your API View."},{"order":13,"type":"code","text":"REST_FRAMEWORK = {
    'DEFAULT_PAGINATION_CLASS': 'rest_framework.pagination.PageNumberPagination',
    'PAGE_SIZE': 10,
    'DEFAULT_FILTER_BACKENDS': [
        'django_filters.rest_framework.DjangoFilterBackend',
        'rest_framework.filters.SearchFilter',
        'rest_framework.filters.OrderingFilter',
    ]
}"},{"order":14,"type":"subheading","text":"Step 3: Configuring the ViewSet"},{"order":15,"type":"paragraph","text":"Next, configure your ModelViewSet to specify which fields can be filtered, searched, and ordered. Consider a scenario where you have an Article model."},{"order":16,"type":"code","text":"from rest_framework import viewsets
from .models import Article
from .serializers import ArticleSerializer

class ArticleViewSet(viewsets.ModelViewSet):
    queryset = Article.objects.all().order_by('-created_at')
    serializer_class = ArticleSerializer
    filterset_fields = ['category', 'is_published']
    search_fields = ['title', 'content', 'author__username']
    ordering_fields = ['created_at', 'title']"},{"order":17,"type":"subheading","text":"Step 4: Testing Your API Endpoints"},{"order":18,"type":"paragraph","text":"Once your ViewSet and settings are in place, you can query your API using URL query parameters. Here are examples of how clients can interact with your newly implemented features:"},{"order":19,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Pagination: GET /api/articles/?page=2"},{"order":20,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Filtering: GET /api/articles/?category=technology&is_published=true"},{"order":21,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Searching: GET /api/articles/?search=django"},{"order":22,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Ordering: GET /api/articles/?ordering=title or GET /api/articles/?ordering=-created_at"},{"order":23,"type":"subheading","text":"Conclusion"},{"order":24,"type":"paragraph","text":"By combining DRF's built-in pagination classes and filter backends with django-filter, you can drastically improve your Django API performance and developer experience. Always remember to optimize your database indexes for fields that are heavily searched or filtered."}]
